origin.source: runAgent onTrace mapped onto OpenTelemetry spans, shipped to LangSmith's OTLP endpoint; typechecks standalone with local @opentelemetry/* shims (OTel is not a repo dependency)

comparison.purpose: Map the versioned AgentTraceEvent stream onto OTel spans (run.start -> root span, request.start/end -> child spans, request.error -> exception, run.end -> status) and export to LangSmith via OTLP; env-gated so it prints the trace stream to stdout without keys.
